title: N. 42nd Street Becomes Lion's Way - NewsBreak
text:
By Zoria Goodley No media credit provided. ,
2 hours ago
WACO, Texas ( FOX 44 ) – Waco High School Alumni and students gathered in front of the school this afternoon for the unveiling of their new ‘Lion’s Way’ street sign. The unveiling of the new street sign highlights a full slate of homecoming week celebrations at the newly built Waco High School campus.
“For the culture, for the tradition, you know, having a —World War One historic air base and us coming here and being here, it means a lot to me and my family, but more importantly, it means a lot to our community,” said Joseph Alexander, the principal of Waco High School.
That same Lion pride spread across the crowd as they celebrated this new milestone in the school’s history.
The ‘Lion’s Way’ sign will be replacing the N. 42nd Street sign, as the street flows directly into the campus’s very own ‘Lion’s Way’ inside the building, for seniors like Shanija Smith, being about to witness this historic moment before she crosses the stage and graduates was heartwarming.
“I’m actually so excited that this happened on my own last year. I’m very grateful because we want to bring something home. We, the class of 2026, we’re bringing something home. We’re making history,” she said.
For students, staff, and alumni alike, ‘Lion’s Way’ is more than a street; it’s a reminder that Waco High history is still being written.
